last.verdict: Shares edged up as faster cloud growth outweighed a sharp profit decline.

reasons.label: Cloud speeds up
reasons.text: Alibaba Cloud's outside revenue grew 45%, with AI product sales tripling for a twelfth straight quarter.

reasons.label: Profit drops sharply
reasons.text: Adjusted net profit fell 38% to 20.7 billion yuan, missing the 25.4 billion forecast.

reasons.label: Heavy AI spending
reasons.text: Capital spending rose 75% to 67.7 billion yuan, squeezing earnings; a 550 million euro EU fine also hit.

story: Cloud growth has climbed from 36% in the December quarter to 45% now, but profit keeps shrinking as AI spending rises. The stock fell over 8% after the March report, then rose after the May report.
